Audit.MemoryProfile.MethodNote: Detected by comparing WMI's ConfiguredClockSpeed / Speed. Many motherboards report the same value in both fields: the absence of a gap doesn't prove the profile is active, only that no throttling is visible here. Check the BIOS if in doubt.

GameSession.Title: Game session
GameSession.Hero.IdleSubtitle: {0} settings will be applied when you start, then put back as they were when you stop.
GameSession.Hero.ActiveSubtitle: Stop it when you're done playing. Everything goes back to how it was.
GameSession.Tweaks.PowerPlan: Switches to Ultimate Performance if your PC offers it, otherwise to High performance.
GameSession.Tweaks.MousePrecision: Turns off mouse acceleration so your movements stay consistent. Third-party software (gaming mouse, manufacturer driver) can turn it back on during the session.
GameSession.Tweaks.UsbSuspend: Stops Windows from putting your USB ports to sleep. On most PCs the effect is too small to measure. It mostly helps if your mouse or headset drops out mid-game. It only applies to the power plan that is active at start: if Windows switches plans during the session, the setting does not follow.

GameSession.Feedback.Stopped: Session stopped. Your settings are back to how they were.
